header.showTitle: Show the title next to the logo in the header
header.hideHeroTitle: Hide title and subtitle on the homepage (the logo contains them)
header.hint: Only applies when a logo is set.

footer.title: Footer
footer.hint: Columns with text (Markdown), links or logos. Without columns and bottom text, the one-line default footer stays.
footer.urlHint: https://… for external sites, /page/imprint for portal pages.
footer.includeFooterPages: Append pages placed in the footer
footer.uploadHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF up to 5 MB.

notice.title: Usage notice
notice.hint: Shown to every visitor once per browser as a dialog before using the portal.
notice.showAgainHint: Increases the version: visitors who accepted the notice see it once more after saving.
